brief: UBS's Systematic Advisory Deleveraging Alert Indicator has triggered for US equity long/short strategies. Hedge funds cut gross exposure by -2.3 standard deviations on Wednesday, -2.1 std on Thursday and -0.4 std on Friday last week, with the de-grossing concentrated in Hyperscaler stocks. Friday's de-grossing was notably modest relative to what the day's price action would have implied. That shortfall in de-grossing, combined with continued pressure in Hyperscaler names and the resulting hit to performance, is what triggered the indicator. Europe faced similar performance pressure last week, but de-grossing there was more moderate, staying under 1 standard deviation in each session, so the Europe indicator has not triggered. Japan's indicator also remains off.
